entity_name: Mobile Network Operators (مشغلو شبكات الهاتف الخلوي)

facts.value: Category placeholder for the relevant mobile/cellular provider when a complaint concerns cellular signal, mobile data, SIM/package service, or operator billing rather than fixed OGERO infrastructure.
facts.human_review_reason: Specific operator must be identified before direct operator dispatch.

facts.value: Use operator-first handling when provider is known; escalate to TRA for regulatory or unresolved consumer complaints. Fixed internet, landline, cabinet, copper, and fiber faults remain OGERO-first.
facts.human_review_reason: Operator-specific channels are not yet normalized in the KB.
